_comment: Hand edits on top of the OpenStreetMap draft of Höje Taastrup (scripts/stations/draft_from_osm.py), BUILDOUT O5 batch 2 (2026-10-29). Drafted from OSM only so far; facts from DSB's or Banedanmark's station page, photos or a walk go here with their source. Level names are placeholders until a plan or signage names them.

levels.name: Platforms: perron 1 (spor 1/2) and perron 2 (spor 3/4) regional 55 cm; perron 3 (spor 11/12) S-tog 92 cm
levels.name_source: Banedanmark Netredegørelse 2027 Bilag 3.6 + Banedanmark Open Data (platform register /home/claude/dk/out/dk_register), read 2026-10-30; Wikipedia, "Høje Taastrup railway station", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/H%C3%B8je_Taastrup_railway_station, read 2026-10-30

sources.note: Danmarks Højdemodel, © Klimadatastyrelsen, CC BY 4.0: building and roof heights and the ground (3D research pass; pack in data/stations/research/gtfs_72888).
Banedanmark Netredegørelse 2027, Bilag 3.6 (facts): platform heights (3D research pass; data/stations/research/banedanmark_platforms_DK.csv).

changelog.what: First draft from OSM (BUILDOUT O5 batch 2).

Platform heights from Banedanmark Netredegørelse 2027, Bilag 3.6 (facts); 21 buildings, roofs and footbridges with laser heights; the ground as a 5 m grid (3D research pass, data/stations/research/gtfs_72888).

1–2._source: Banedanmark Netredegørelse 2027, Bilag 3.6 (facts), Banedanmark Netredegørelse 2027, Bilag 3.6 "Perronlængder og -højder" (table dated 1 August 2023), read 2026-10-30; TIB 1: tracks 1,2, class 55 cm = 0.55 m above rail, 339 m long; a recorded design class, not a survey

3–4._source: Banedanmark Netredegørelse 2027, Bilag 3.6 (facts), Banedanmark Netredegørelse 2027, Bilag 3.6 "Perronlængder og -højder" (table dated 1 August 2023), read 2026-10-30; TIB 1: tracks 3,4, class 55 cm = 0.55 m above rail, 339 m long; a recorded design class, not a survey

11–12._source: Banedanmark Netredegørelse 2027, Bilag 3.6 (facts), Banedanmark Netredegørelse 2027, Bilag 3.6 "Perronlængder og -højder" (table dated 1 August 2023), read 2026-10-30; TIB 81: tracks 11,12, class 92 cm = 0.92 m above rail, 223 m long; a recorded design class, not a survey
